title: Cost & Token Analytics
description: Spend and token usage straight from cost_analytics.usage_records (see ADR-0002 — one schema per service, queried directly here since this is a read-only reporting view, not a service-to-service call). A different kind of dashboard than Service HTTP Overview: business metrics from Postgres rather than infra metrics from Prometheus.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS total FROM cost_analytics.usage_records WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT model, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM cost_analytics.usage_records WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, model, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM cost_analytics.usage_records WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, model ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM cost_analytics.usage_records WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
